symptom: `diff-local` counted a domain model as modified after `grant read *, write * on entity Shop.Customer to Shop.User;` and printed only `Summary: 0 new, 1 modified, 0 deleted` — no hunk for the access change
cause: domainModelBsonToMDL rendered entities and attributes from the raw map but never their access rules, so a grant/revoke rendered identically on both sides and `Current == Proposed` swallowed it
insight: Same class as #1393/#1080: whatever a diff-local renderer does not print is a silent diff, and the summary still counts the unit. Do not read access rules off the raw map: the roles are stored as `AllowedModuleRoles` (the SDK says ModuleRoles), so a hand-written reader is one storage-name typo from rendering nothing on both sides again. Decode through the backend (`ParseDomainModelFromRaw`, the ParseMicroflowFromRaw pattern) and reuse DESCRIBE ENTITY's `outputEntityAccessGrants`; the backend test compares the raw decode against `GetDomainModelByID` rule by rule on the fixture, and fails if the fixture had no role-bearing rule to compare. Cheapest real repro: copy testdata/pedapp, `git init`, exec + commit, grant, `diff-local --ref X~1..X` — the old binary prints the bare summary.
